narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a surprise planned by a team for their member, Ian, at a triathlon documentary premiere. It captures the behind-the-scenes coordination and the emotional moment when a special guest, a coach Ian thought couldn't attend, appears on stage to present a gift, highlighting themes of friendship and gratitude.
